state.whole_fight_sim: Each option uses its own recorded sample count (adaptive-v1, cap 100); paired differences use only shared seed prefixes. Eliminated means sampling stopped, not an unavailable action. Whole-fight model estimates remain conditional and calibrated under the original trust gate.
state.boss_relative_margin_objective: Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_evaluation明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。
state.whole_fight_plan: the simulation's best line, from its samples (information, not an order): T2 play 触媒; T4 the enemies hit hardest (incoming ~57); no plan wins in most samples: 0/50 won, the fight ends ~T7
state.whole_fight_sim_trust: 低可信 (low trust): the simulator is not validated on this boss (校准 Brier 0.151996，高于整体 0.104418 的 1.25 倍 0.130523). Its numbers are shown only because this fight is an SL retry, to help find another approach; no option is ranked by them.

previous_attempts.note: SL retry: this fight was reloaded from its start (the game's save from entering the room) because the earlier attempt(s) below reached a certain death. The deck, the draws and the enemy moves are the same as long as the plays are the same, so playing the same way loses the same way: look for a different line (when to block, which enemy to kill first, when to drink which potion, which cards to set up). Information, not an order: the options and their numbers are unchanged and you still choose. The draw pile comes in the same order whatever you play (a card drawn earlier just arrives earlier), until the discard pile is reshuffled: known_draws lists the next cards when they are known.
